# `stealth` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "stealth" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/stealth/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required | Unique table id; the game reads "stealth". |
| `notes` | string | required | Where the numbers come from (bead, tuning status). |
| `visibility` | object | required | Visibility model weights (mw-e09.2). |
| `visibility.light` | object | required | Light term: the target’s light samples, combined, then lifted by the observer’s dark vision (seen = level + (1 − level) × darkVision, so dark vision 1 sees full light), read on the curve. |
| `visibility.light.curve` | list of object (at least 2) | required | Light term by seen light level: points in rising level order, from level 0 to level 1. |
| `visibility.light.curve[].level` | number 0–1 | required | Light level seen by the observer, 0–1 (after dark vision). |
| `visibility.light.curve[].term` | number 0–2 | required | Light term at that level, 0–2. |
| `visibility.light.peakWeight` | number 0–1 | required | How the target’s light samples combine, 0–1: 0 = their mean, 1 = the brightest; a lit head on a body in shadow still shows. |
| `visibility.stance` | object | required | Stance term per stance, 0–2. |
| `visibility.stance.prone` | number 0–2 | required | Lying flat. |
| `visibility.stance.crouched` | number 0–2 | required | Crouched. |
| `visibility.stance.standing` | number 0–2 | required | Standing (1 = neutral). |
| `visibility.motion` | list of object (at least 1) | required | Motion term by horizontal speed: bands in rising fromSpeed order; the fastest band the speed reaches applies. |
| `visibility.motion[].fromSpeed` | number 0–50 | required | Horizontal speed at which this band starts, m/s; the first band starts at 0. |
| `visibility.motion[].term` | number 0–2 | required | Motion term in this band, 0–2. |
| `visibility.profile` | object | required | Profile modifiers on top of the equipment brightness the target supplies (both multiply). |
| `visibility.profile.cloak` | number 0–2 | required | Multiplier while a cloak or other concealing garment is worn. |
| `visibility.profile.disguise` | number 0–2 | required | Multiplier while disguised. |
| `visibility.distance` | list of object (at least 2) | required | Distance falloff: points in rising distance order from 0 m, never rising; flat past the last. |
| `visibility.distance[].metres` | number 0–500 | required | Observer-to-target distance, m. |
| `visibility.distance[].term` | number 0–2 | required | Distance falloff at that distance, 0–2. |
| `visibility.contrast` | object | required | Contrast rule: a dark figure against bright background light stands out. |
| `visibility.contrast.backgroundThreshold` | number 0–1 | required | Background light at or above which a target is silhouetted against it, 0–1. |
| `visibility.contrast.darkTargetMax` | number 0–1 | required | The target counts as dark (a silhouette) when its own combined light is at or below this, 0–1. |
| `visibility.contrast.bonus` | number 0–2 | required | Added to a silhouetted target’s light term (capped at the full-light term), 0–2. |
| `noise` | object | required | Sound propagation (mw-e09.3): a noise loses 20·log10(d) dB over a path of d metres (none within 1 m) plus the gain of every door, wall and floor it passes. |
| `noise.audibleFloor` | number 0–60 | required | Global audibility floor, dB: below it a sound is not heard and propagation stops searching. |
| `noise.doors` | object | required | Portal gains by door state; a closed door that does not block sound (a grille) counts as open. Gains must never rise from open to ajar to closed. |
| `noise.doors.open` | number -120–0 | required | Gain through an open (or broken) door, dB (≤ 0). |
| `noise.doors.ajar` | number -120–0 | required | Gain through a door part-way open or moving, dB (≤ 0). |
| `noise.doors.closed` | number -120–0 | required | Gain through a closed door that muffles sound (`blocks.sound`), dB (≤ 0). |
| `noise.doors.materials` | list of object | `[]` | Per leaf material overrides (iron muffles more than planks). |
| `noise.doors.materials[].material` | id | required | Material id of the door leaf (a door profile’s `material`). |
| `noise.doors.materials[].open` | number -120–0 | — | Gain while open, dB (≤ 0); omitted: the default. |
| `noise.doors.materials[].ajar` | number -120–0 | — | Gain while ajar (moving or stopped part-way), dB (≤ 0). |
| `noise.doors.materials[].closed` | number -120–0 | — | Gain while closed, dB (≤ 0). |
| `noise.partitions` | object | required | Transmission through walls and floors between adjacent rooms. |
| `noise.partitions.wall` | number -120–0 | required | Default gain through a wall between side-by-side rooms, dB (≤ 0). |
| `noise.partitions.floor` | number -120–0 | required | Default gain through a floor or ceiling between stacked rooms, dB (≤ 0). |
| `noise.partitions.materials` | list of object | `[]` | Per material overrides; a scene names a partition’s material. |
| `noise.partitions.materials[].material` | id | required | Material id of the partition. |
| `noise.partitions.materials[].wall` | number -120–0 | — | Gain through a wall of it, dB (≤ 0); omitted: the default. |
| `noise.partitions.materials[].floor` | number -120–0 | — | Gain through a floor or ceiling of it, dB (≤ 0); omitted: the default. |
| `noise.impact` | object | required | Impact noise (mw-e03.25): loudness = refDb + dbPerDecade·log10(energy / refEnergy) plus the louder of the two materials’ surface loudness offsets, capped at maxDb; below minEnergy, silence. |
| `noise.impact.minEnergy` | number > 0 | required | Least impact energy, J, that makes a noise: softer settling stays silent. |
| `noise.impact.refEnergy` | number > 0 | required | Energy, J, at which the curve reads `refDb`. |
| `noise.impact.refDb` | number 0–120 | required | Loudness, dB at 1 m, of a `refEnergy` impact on stone. |
| `noise.impact.dbPerDecade` | number > 0 ≤ 40 | required | dB gained for ten times the energy. |
| `noise.impact.maxDb` | number 0–120 | required | Loudest an impact gets, dB at 1 m. |
| `noise.footsteps` | object | required | Footstep noise (mw-e09.5): loudness = gait dB + the surface’s offset + the wearer’s equipment dB (20·log10 of the noise multiplier, ADR-0003) + a creak when the board has one. |
| `noise.footsteps.gaitDb` | object | required | Base loudness of one step by gait, before surface and equipment. |
| `noise.footsteps.gaitDb.sneak` | number 0–120 | required | Crouched or slow-walking step, dB at 1 m on stone (25). |
| `noise.footsteps.gaitDb.walk` | number 0–120 | required | Walking step, dB at 1 m on stone (40). |
| `noise.footsteps.gaitDb.run` | number 0–120 | required | Running step, dB at 1 m on stone (55). |
| `noise.footsteps.gaitDb.sprint` | number 0–120 | required | Sprinting step, dB at 1 m on stone (65). |
| `noise.footsteps.creatureGait` | object | required | A creature has no controller: its gait is read from the speed it moves at (patrols walk, chases run). |
| `noise.footsteps.creatureGait.walkFrom` | number 0–20 | required | Speed, m/s, at which a creature steps. |
| `noise.footsteps.creatureGait.runFrom` | number 0–20 | required | Speed, m/s, a creature steps as a run. |
| `noise.footsteps.creatureGait.sprintFrom` | number 0–30 | required | Speed, m/s, a creature steps as a sprint. |
| `noise.footsteps.creatureGait.stride` | object | required | Ground distance between steps per gait (the player’s: 0.75, 1.6, 2.05). |
| `noise.footsteps.creatureGait.stride.walk` | number > 0 ≤ 5 | required | Metres between a walking creature’s steps. |
| `noise.footsteps.creatureGait.stride.run` | number > 0 ≤ 5 | required | Metres between a running creature’s steps. |
| `noise.footsteps.creatureGait.stride.sprint` | number > 0 ≤ 5 | required | Metres between a sprinting creature’s steps. |
| `noise.footsteps.landing` | object | required | Landing impulse by fall height (the height whose free fall reaches the speed). |
| `noise.footsteps.landing.minHeight` | number 0–10 | required | Fall height, m, below which a landing is just a step: silent. |
| `noise.footsteps.landing.curve` | list of object (at least 2) | required | Piecewise-linear loudness by fall height, flat beyond its ends. |
| `noise.footsteps.landing.curve[].height` | number 0–100 | required | Fall height, m. |
| `noise.footsteps.landing.curve[].db` | number 0–120 | required | Loudness, dB at 1 m on stone, of a landing from it. |
